data.one_liner: A pure Dart implementation of RevenueCat for in-app purchases and subscriptions with Web Billing.
data.what_it_does: Facilitates in-app purchases and subscriptions using Web Billing. It provides APIs to configure the client, retrieve customer info and offerings, get web checkout URLs, and manage virtual currencies.
use_when: You want to integrate RevenueCat Web Billing in a Flutter or pure Dart application.
You need to manage subscriptions and in-app purchases across multiple platforms including web.
avoid_when: You are using the old Stripe-based configuration, which was removed in version 2.0.0.
You only need standard native store purchases without Web Billing.
strengths: Closely follows native APIs from purchases_flutter.
Supports cross-platform apps including web, mobile, and desktop.
weaknesses: Requires external tools like url_launcher and app_links to handle web checkouts and deep links.
Web purchases require configuring Web Purchase Links in the RevenueCat Dashboard.
data.setup_notes: Requires configuring PurchasesDart with a Web Billing API key and an appUserId, along with setting up Web Purchase Links in the RevenueCat dashboard.

alternatives.name: in_app_purchase
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want official Flutter support for standard native App Store and Google Play billing instead of RevenueCat Web Billing.

alternatives.name: adapty_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer using Adapty as an alternative subscription management platform.
